item.title: Registration And Login
item.description: 1. Account registration link Registration information overview: Email: used for account login and registration security code acquisition Security code: Enter a valid email address to send the security code Username: Platform users can use it as the platform account to log in Password: Platform account password Time zone: Account time zone. The platform will select different time zone offsets for time display based on the different account time zones Installer information: No need to change by default.

item.title: Quick Start
item.description: Solarhub App Overview link1. Registration and Login linkFor details, please refer to Registration and Login 2. Creating a Device linkNewly registered accounts need to create a device first. Click Create Device Add the device by scanning a QR code or manually entering the serial number. Enter the network configuration interface Enter the Wi-Fi password to configure the network. During configuration, please ensure that the device and the phone being configured are on the same 2.
